English: I hope you'll continue to stand with us.

Thanks, mercs. And keep it down?there's a whole mess of those assholes across the road. I'm heading back to our camp.
Thank you for saving our comrade.

Cabin in the Woods

On behalf of the Maquis, Grand Chien's resistance, I call on you to stand with us against the Legion?and against anyone who would strangle our shared ideals for power and profit. We can discuss your reward.
Hurry...

That's right, gentlemen. We've got a fight ahead of us. We'll handle the mines by the bridge and set up defenses at key positions. We're counting on your help. As usual, you don't really have a choice.
Legion Field Camp
Our client is waiting on Ernie Island. We need to break through to the target sector?the contract still stands.
So... Maleko did call for help after all.

...Take it. Who am I to stop you?

The doctor wasn't lying. They really do want that lighthouse. Get ready to fight!
I hope you're not afraid of needles. I've got something for you.
Rebel Bunker
Uncharted Area
Fuck, we need to get the lighthouse defenses ready?those red-and-black fuckers are already here!
Rebel Base on Ernie Island

Yeah, there was a whole gang of bunglers here. They arrived on the boat "Pride", hung around the bars, and claimed they were protecting us from the Legion. Then they headed inland, and no one's seen them since.
All right. See you after the fight, then.
Jungle Coast

I never thought I'd ask the war dogs of capital for help, but it seems the enemy of my enemy is my friend. Besides, we have no choice. I've got wounded and exhausted fighters everywhere, almost no ammunition, and what little we managed to carry out can barely be called weapons anymore...
Mountain Outpost
Nameless Backcountry
Looks like we made it! Thank you, mercenaries. You'll always be welcome here.
They are holding innocent people prisoner in .
Hyena Den
Here. This'll help you take out sentries quietly at night.
Is that everything?
A large Legion force will arrive soon. Help the locals prepare their defenses.

You've done a great deal for us. Thank you, mercenaries. Another man in your dangerous line of work washed up here?a fellow soldier of fortune. I think he'd gladly join you. At first he kept raving about some nonexistent country called Arulco, but he seems to be over that now. He may have lost his memory, but he certainly hasn't lost his fighting skills. That's him by the tents.
Smugglers' Reserve Camp
Operation <color EmStyle>"N-Night"</color>: <color EmStyle>Crazy Hannah</color> has agreed to fight
All right. Stay close to the locals?I don't think we have much time.
Road Bridge
I... understand...
That's a shame. If you change your mind, I'm sure we'll meet again.
Port Cacao Fortifications
The Wilds
Burial Grounds
But tell me?who are you? You're certainly no farmers, and you don't look like soldiers either. Some kind of elite commandos? Mercenaries, like the ones who came before you?

Weapons. We need the supplies from our old camp, and there should be medicine there as well. I have no one left to send: my fighters are wounded and exhausted, our weapons are falling apart, and we've already taken too many losses. I hope you have an explosives expert?we mined the approaches. Bring back the supplies, and I'll find something to share with you.
Lighthouse Road
There's one more thing, if you're still willing to help.
Marshy Shore

I'm glad you care about what's happening. There's no time for the whole story, so here's the short version: the Legion spread across the country, and the rebel cells were scattered and cut off from one another. We tried to retake the island, but they drove us from our positions, and now we're holed up here. I hope the others are faring better. You probably saw the bodies below. We barely have anything left to shoot, no medicine, and hardly any food.
Greetings, soldiers.
Old Port
Marshes

Rocky Shore
Too bad. Then go your own way and stay out of ours.
Lighthouse Road
I can help with that. If you need us, we'll back you up.
Greetings, mercenaries.
Until next time.
Impassable Terrain
The landing went wrong: the boats came under heavy fire from shore. Secure a foothold in the sector and make contact with whoever has already engaged the enemy.
There are several camps around the villa. They're massing for a coordinated assault.
Abandoned Bunker Entrance

Like I said, we need weapons, ammunition, and medical supplies. If you're willing to drive the Legion dogs out of the camp, I'll even provide fire support. But first... we need to save one of our fighters. He should still be alive?they're holding him on the pier. Those dogs are going to execute him. He covered our retreat from the second camp. Please, save him.
She's... young. Beautiful. The Legion takes girls like that and sells them to Maman in Pantagruel. Unless they keep them for themselves...
Jungle Shore
If I told you, they wouldn't be secret anymore.
Central Strongpoint

But reaching her won't be easy. The Legion has the villa under siege, with troops all around it, waiting for the right moment to strike. If you want to get inside, you'll have to break through the cordon.
Lighthouse Infirmary
Sanatorium Basement
Deep Marshes
Too bad. See you at camp?if you make it there.
Then come to our camp in sector L1. Find me there, or Commandante Kasongo?he's our leader on the island.
Treasure Hunters' Settlement

It's all his fault. He gassed all those innocent people to frame you! It's impossible to do business in this country?there's nothing but blood and chaos. Let me go, and I'll do everything in my power to restore your good name.
Those mercenaries should never have brought you here! Prison is exactly where you belong!
Darling, your blush is fabulous, but even it can't hide how much you blush when you lie.
Oh... yes, that man is definitely dangerous!
They're obviously using you to do their dirty work. I can help you get out?money, passports... anything you want! Just don't hit me!
I hear that a lot, but no. Sorry. I'm just a little gray mouse.
Incorrect. Only we knew that?and, unsurprisingly, so did you.
Of course not. We're merely exploring our options.

He may be the most powerful warlord in Grand Chien. Little is known about him, except that the Legion has built something like a cult of personality around him. The bandits worship him and fear him in equal measure. To save your father, you'll probably have to face the Major himself.
Listen, you! You have no right to threaten me. I terminated our contract, and then you ran off and made yourself a local bandit king!
Right. Fidel does not understand. We kill Emma now, or... what?
Try a little harder next time, huh? I barely broke a sweat. If you want to live, learn how.
Hell, everybody's got a family. Why should I give a damn?
Coconuts and bananas. I understand, don't worry. He'll probably kill more Legion bastards in your hands than in ours.
Don't worry, sister! We take those iron things apart. Everyting gonna be irie!
Naturally, they failed. No one has heard from them since, while the Major is still very much alive.
In my opinion, you should stay out of this godforsaken hole's affairs. But the decision is yours.
We met a rebel known as Ghost. He proposed a joint attack on the Lookout (sector M4).
You led them here? Uh-oh. That's not good. I've always liked quiet mice better than rats.
You don't have to look tough. Looking good is enough?and you could use a little work, of course.
Cut the crap, lady, or I'll beat it out of you.
He's fine, really. And he'd be better off if you put down that gun and helped him rebuild Ernie.
All right, all right, there's no need to threaten me! I'll tell you anything you want.
Yes?the diet version of A.I.M. All the blandness, none of the fun.
All right, just don't torture me. I said I'm willing to help. What do you need?
Money is good, but all this fighting made Omryn hungry. Got anything to eat?
As they say... you got what you paid for.
Should we be worried about that? I can take a stab in the back. Just don't aim any lower.
Why?! I told you everything you asked for!
Then sit there and rot. See if I care.
Yes! Call family. Let them watch too, eh?
Ah! Fidel loves mines too! Maybe Fidel takes these mines, and you run while you still have legs?

In exchange for financial backing, he promised me a monopoly on diamond mining in the valley. But I swear on my honor, I had no idea he planned to kill those people and frame you. Here is the contract I signed with him. Please, let me go.
This... well... isn't relevant to your assignment. From time to time, we have to deal with minor... logistical issues. Again, my apologies. Do you have any other questions?
Everything is fine. But try to be a better son to him. For example, don't kill his friends.
Of course. I'll tell you everything I know. I'm sure information like that will persuade you to let me go.
We didn't trust Graaf either! That's why we hired on?to keep an eye on him. Can't let a bad boy run wild without supervision, can we?
Yes. This was before he kidnapped the president. He seized our diamond mines and refused to negotiate, so I took the only course of action available to me.
I don't want money?just let me go!
Life's full of mysteries, man. Only one way to find out.
A wolf would give up meat before I'd take a vacation on your dime.
Your wife has a few questions for a girl named Deedee.
My name is Dyalo, but most people call me Ghost.
Ha... now that was a massacre. Glad we're on the same side.
We bested you once. We will do so again.

All I know is that they stayed here briefly before heading to the mainland. I lost contact with them soon after they landed. I'm sure the locals can tell you more. Biff and his people, how should I put it... weren't exactly discreet.
Kiki is in sector M3.
The German cache is in sector M1.
Ha! It has been too long since Fidel killed someone! His hands are itching.
Is that it? It doesn't exactly inspire confidence that you'll be able to pay us at all.
...And there you go lying again.
Fidel likes this. Fidel can kill him, yes? Hmm?
Ha ha ha! Fidel needs body parts.
Ah! Fidel loves mines! So much dynamite. Such joy!
Ooh, that's a long way. Better pack plenty of food.
Finally, something true out of you.
All right. What's the catch?
Kiki... Kiki's alive...
I... I owe you. Take it. It's everything I have.
I believe we can negotiate a discount. Just imagine: a shootout breaks out... How terribly unpleasant and unhygienic it would be to bleed out in this filth.
I have nothing to do with that psychopath. He's been extorting money from me ever since I appointed him regional director of Adonis. Then again, occupational hazards like this are nothing new to me.
You can lie low for a while. Once this unfortunate affair blows over, you'll have plenty of other contracts. I know at least one company that could use people with your talents.
You're not hunting Wolf, kid. Wolf is hunting you. And if Wolf is looking at you, he's already got you in his sights. You get the idea.
Oh, I love mines! So many little holes to hide in.
And I have muscles too. Many muscles!
No. Fidel likes to aim for the stomach. More screams that way. Hmm?

They are the largest illegal armed force in the region. Their leader styles himself the Major. They seized all our diamond mines before our security teams could intervene. They excel at brutalizing civilians, but lack intelligence and training. Professional soldiers like you should make short work of them.
Well, I'd like to see the benefits package first. But when it comes to compensation, I'm flexible. Very flexible.
Nothing... except a diamond. You can have it. It's all I have. Just save her.
Thank you, mercenaries. I found a crate of grenades on the shore. Here, take it.
By the waterfall... in a cage.
Hello again. What did you want to discuss?

I'm merely a victim of circumstances. I came here to do business, not dodge bullets. I understand that this turn of events has upset you, and I'm willing to help. Let's start over. Tell me what you need.
Excuse me?! I'm not your dog!
All right, run away in terror! You might shoot each other!
But why let him go? Fidel does not understand. Ah! Maybe we shoot him later? Hmm?
Clear Sector K3
Clear Sector K5
Clear Sector L3
Clear Sector L4
Clear Sector L5
This is what Fidel always says: there is no such thing as an innocent bystander. When shooting starts, you either pass by and hide, or stay and shoot. Ay-ya!
Baby... a worthy rival for me has yet to be born.
Yes?.. No! Just tell them to wait... They are to wait for the signal, understood?
Who is this "Mercy"? Why let him go? He said we could take his life!
So... bad news?
What's more, the scattered Legion forces will no longer be able to assault the villa as effectively, making them much easier to handle.
And yet, for some reason, I'm certain you and the Legion are... uh... "one big family."
Give my regards to your handsome daddy!
I must point out that you're a rather poor liar.
Looks like we should pay that place another visit.
Innocent bystanders are just people who haven't taken a shot at me yet.
If I got a coin for every promise like that, I'd own an island by now.
Soon, the only ones in danger will be the bastards who kidnapped your father.
Ha! Herman, you dance like a pregnant pig! Knees up!
Fidel has come to take what is his.
Heavy equipment? Trucks, bulldozers? What she need those for, man?
Tale as old as time. I'm not even angry, just... disappointed, I suppose.
But why? You're mercenaries?you work for money! Let me pay for a vacation while I settle matters here. You could clearly use some time off, couldn't you?
Ahem. My apologies. Where were we?
Yes. There's a waterfall farther down the road. We'll go around it and wait for you at the Lookout.
There's a small Legion force by the river near the waterfall. They're trying to cut off Burda's squad, but they don't know about the secret paths along the mountains.
If anyone is going to put my Herman in a noose, it'll be me!
Um... Is it just me, or?hic?did that sound like a threat?
This your fortress, man? Looks more like a junkyard to me.
I hope not, man?for your own sake.
I'm watching you, bandit.
Emma? So that's why you're here... Yes, I know where she is. The girl is brave?too brave for her age. She's sheltering in the villa to the north, in sector K4.

Complicated doesn't begin to cover it. In short, our cell is cut off from the mainland. The Legion overran the entire country in no time, and Ernie Island became the last stronghold of the resistance. The president's daughter is hiding in the center of the island; they say that rat Corazon is with her. There's also a smugglers' base here. We aren't exactly friends, but they sell us weapons, and we manage to coexist. The Legion is everywhere: some sectors are still holding out, while others have been swallowed by the red plague.
Well... everyone knows that the Major's name is Spike Scallion.
There is no such thing as too much violence! Ha ha ha!
Looks like he and his gang are dug in tighter than a tick. How're we supposed to get in there?
Bonus pay is good. Food is good too.
Wide-open ground is the perfect place for a climactic shootout!
Yes, of course. I want nothing more to do with this affair.
Yes. The fascist must die.
Your first priority remains unchanged: restore our control over the diamond mines and rescue the president. But if you learn what happened to the M.E.R.C. mercenaries, report back to me immediately.
Well, I should get home before Martha starts nagging me again... How much can one man take, for fuck's sake...
I can't wait to make him regret it.
Fidel does not need money. Fidel needs blood, screams, and... body parts. Ha ha!
Oh, yes! The boys in the Legion respect me for it. Whenever they visit, they're terribly polite and bring me all sorts of useful bomb parts!
Not a bad appetizer. Let's get to the main course.
Frontier justice is harsh, kemosabe.
...Holy chicken leg, I think I stepped on...
How about a fistful of teeth? I'll knock them out of your mouth first.

Really? Well... yes, but why would they report it? Broadcasting something like that would only spread panic through the neighboring towns. I merely assumed it might have been gas. It's the most practical way to kill a great many people at once.
Time for you and your bandits to mosey on out. Move!
And don't forget Stella's compensation. For... emotional distress.
Honestly? I think you've got potential. I can see it now: opening a travel agency, leading tours...
Well, at least the girl tried.
Nice speech. I dozed off halfway through.
Get out while you can, and don't ever set foot in this town again!

For what? I haven't done anything! Faucheux is to blame for all of this, and your aggression toward me is entirely unjustified. Nevertheless, I'm willing to forget the whole affair and make peace with you.
Ooh, I love secrets! Will you tell me? I'm a mime?you know I won't make a sound.
We're here to return a young lady to her father.
Desperados don't rough a man up. They shoot first.
Run along now, or you'll get another beating.
Now we can kill him, yes? Ah?! Why not?! We have the diamonds, don't we?
That's sweet and all, but that fucking landing filled my ass crack with sand. How about you cough up some more, huh?
Clearly, it did not work. I hope my mistake serves as a lesson: never underestimate the Major.
What is this? An employment contract with Spike Scallion? No, that isn't my signature. I never signed anything with the Major!
